# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 109 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 109

**1** Jesus said: "The kingdom is like a man who had buried treasure in his field — and he didn't know it was there. When he died he left the field to his son. The son didn't know about it either. He inherited the field and sold it. The buyer went out plowing and struck the treasure. He started lending money at interest to anyone who asked."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Buried treasure in his field" — the treasure as buried (clarifying the hiddenness)
- "Struck the treasure" — the discovery as a sudden encounter
- "To anyone who asked" — the moneylending made social and open
